title: Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE: $25 Bonus for World Series, NFL & More
text:
Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE: $25 Bonus for Packers vs Panthers, NBA & NCAAF PGA Tour LPGA College Amateur Golf Life Real Estate Equipment Apparel Newsletters SPORTS Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE: $25 Bonus for Packers vs Panthers, NBA & More (Oct. 29)
 Mark Strotman Oct. 29, 2026, 5:21 p.m. ET NFL Week 8 kicks off tonight when the Packers host the Carolina Panthers in Green Bay and the state of Wisconsin will still be rocking after the Brewers' World Series title last night. Get rocking yourself with $25 in credit to your account for this game, the NBA and more by using the Polymarket invite code SBWIRE , depositing $10 and making a trade.
 Polymarket bills itself as the largest prediction market exchange anywhere. Eligible users in 49 states and Washington, D.C. can sign up, with Nevada the one state left out. Instead of taking a sportsbook's number, you buy and sell shares in outcomes like Super Bowl winners, division and conference champions, MVP races and player props, with prices quoted in cents that mirror what the crowd believes.
 The board also includes college football action, NHL, UFC, politics, world events and crypto. Use a PLAY NOW button here to enter the Polymarket invite code SBWIRE .
 Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE Snags $25 Bonus
 Bonus: Deposit $10, Get $25
 Polymarket Invite Code: SBWIRE 
 Who's Eligible: New users, 18+
 Availability: 49 states and DC (Nevada excluded)
 Last Verified: October 29, 2026 
 Redeeming Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE in 5 Steps
 Use any link on this page to download the Polymarket app through the App Store or Google Play.
 Start a new Polymarket US account and supply the identity information required: your name, address, phone number and Social Security number.
 Type the Polymarket invite code SBWIRE into the code field while you register.
 Add $10 or more using Apple Pay, Google Pay, a debit card or another accepted option.
 Make one qualifying trade and the $25 credit appears in your account.
 The offer is for first-time users only. The credit works on any live event contract.
 What Trading on Polymarket Looks Like
 Think of Polymarket less as a betting site and more as an exchange. People are trading contracts linked to real-world results, from elections and economic reports to football scores.
 Every market asks a yes-or-no question. A share priced at 35 cents means traders collectively estimate a 35% chance. Be right and the share pays $1. Be wrong and it pays nothing. If the odds move before the market settles, you can sell your shares early.
 The NFL Case for the Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE
 Football fans who want to trade the season, not only wager on a single game, will find several upsides here. Polymarket is available in 49 states and D.C., a wider footprint than most licensed sportsbooks, and the age minimum is 18 rather than 21.
 You also deal with other traders, not a house, so the market sets the price. That structure can produce tighter and more open odds, and closing a position early is always an option.
 Once the credit lands, the Polymarket invite code SBWIRE turns a $10 deposit into $35 in trading capital, which is enough to place positions across several NFL markets.
 Legal Status of the Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE
 Polymarket serves U.S. customers through QCEX, an exchange registered with the CFTC, a far steadier legal setup than it had at first. Trades settle in USDC on the Polygon blockchain and can be viewed on-chain.
 Access covers 49 states and D.C. Only Nevada is excluded. Because prediction market rules are still being written, they may change, so read the platform's terms before you deposit. Users must be 18 or older and complete identity verification.
 Polymarket's Referral Program
 Active traders can also earn through Polymarket's referral program, which is separate from the Polymarket invite code . A referral link unlocks at $10,000 in lifetime trading volume. From there, you collect an uncapped portion of the fees generated by people who sign up through you.
 At present, that is 30% of fees from direct referrals and 10% from second-degree referrals over 180 days. Polymarket may adjust these terms. Trading fees range from 0.75% on sports to 1.8% on crypto.
 How to Add Money to Polymarket
 Funding differs from a standard betting app because the system centers on USDC on Polygon. You can still add money in several ways:
 Crypto wallet
 Card payment or fiat transfer
 Cross-chain bridge
 Transfer from another exchange
 PayPal
 Apple Pay
 Apple Cash
 Get Started With the Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE
 Between Thursday night's NFC matchup, a London game and Monday Night Football still ahead, entering the Polymarket invite code SBWIRE at sign-up gets you funded and ready for your first trade.
 Polymarket Invite Code SBWIRE FAQs
 What Is the Minimum Deposit for the Polymarket Bonus?
 The minimum is $10. After you enter SBWIRE and make a qualifying trade, the $25 credit posts to your account without a rollover.
 Which Polymarket Invite Code Is Active?
 SBWIRE . It counts only when entered during registration in the app, and it cannot be added to an existing account.
 Can I Use Polymarket Legally in the U.S.?
 Yes. QCEX, a CFTC-registered exchange, powers it, and it runs in 49 states plus D.C. Nevada is the lone exception. Check the terms for state-specific details, since regulation is still evolving.
 At What Point Should I Enter SBWIRE?
 During sign-up, in the promo field. You get one chance. Then a $10 deposit and a qualifying trade unlock the $25.
